Message:
Several days later,
my brother’s illness came back.

He seems in
more pain than before...
He needs medicine.
Much stronger medicine...!

I can make that happen,
can’t I...?

...N-No!
I am not using
any more of that power.

“Worry not—
you can always
make new memories.”

As God spoke inside my head...
it almost sounded like
a demon whispering.

“If your brother dies,
so does your chance to
make new memories.
Do it now,
before it is too late...”
B-But I...

Suddenly, I felt
my brother’s hand grasp mine.

“See. Your brother is
begging for you to save him.”

...! You’re right—
I have to save my brother.

But, if it means
forgetting about him...

I don’t wanna lose anything!
Not my brother,
not my memories, but...

This is the only way
to save him!

“Even if I forget everything...
please...don’t make me
lose my brother...!”

A blinding light suddenly
envelops all I could see.

Then, something flashes
in my mind—
someone’s silhouette,
tinged in white.
Wait, is that...?

Little by little,
the silhouette is engulfed by the light,
vanishing into the blinding void...
“Don’t go...”

As my consciousness drifts away,
I can almost hear someone
calling out to me...
But, who...?
